DOCS.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of commands to look up.

reply_schema.description: Documentation keyed by lowercase command name. Subcommands are named container|subcommand. Unknown names are skipped. Without names every documented command is returned. On RESP2 every map arrives as a flat array.

additionalProperties.description: The documentation of one command: summary, since, group, complexity, doc_flags, history, reply_schema, arguments and subcommands. Empty fields are left out, group is always present.
